description: Frame-QA category -> how a clip is fixed. One table for the prompt compiler (prevention directives), video.remediate / episode.remediate_videos (automatic retakes) and qa.lessons. Every sentence is a positive description of the wanted picture: video models draw whatever a prompt mentions, so words such as cut, wound, blood, text or any negation never appear here (scripts/qa_remediation_test.rb checks it).

builtin.text: One continuous take from a single camera position; the whole clip stays in the same location with the same framing from the first frame to the last.

remediations.text: Single steady shot: the camera stays on the same place and the same people for the entire clip, matching the first frame from start to end.
The people match their reference pictures exactly: same face, gender, age and outfit.
Dialogue is heard as voice alone; the picture shows only the people and the setting, clean and plain like a film frame.
Hands, wrists, arms, face and neck show smooth, clean, healthy skin throughout; every movement is calm and gentle.
Skin, clothing, bedding and floors keep their natural clean colours throughout; every movement is calm and gentle.
Hair, clothing and accessories stay exactly as in the first frame for the whole clip, and the described action is carried out in full.
The camera holds the shot size and angle described for this shot for the whole clip.
